comparison.objective: Select one requested M4×20 screw from sorted bins and place it in a handoff tray; no spec versions are available.
comparison.physical_skill: Visual size/bin selection, small-object grasping, transport, and release.
comparison.success_condition: Exactly one M4 is released in the tray, wrong sizes remain unmoved, and nothing remains grasped.
comparison.reason: It shares generic small-part picking and tray placement only; it lacks the candidate's aligned bimanual hammering, fracture, and retained-insert protection.
